description: Return one captured LLM exchange with its stored request and response headers and bodies (up to 12 KiB per side; the host cut a body at 32 KiB and `body_truncated` says so). Pass a request_id from `captures`; without one the newest exchange is returned. Exchanges older than the newest 12 no longer keep bodies.

request_id.description: The exchange to read. Defaults to the newest http.exchange record.

include_headers.description: Include request and response headers. Default true.
